title: Exactness from counit-compatible open-cover mates
statement: For the open-cover module mate maps, assuming each mate composed with its adjunction counit is the intersection counit, the resulting short complex is short exact.

proof.text: For each of U, V and their intersection, apply the counit stalk calculation: its underlying abelian stalk map is an isomorphism inside the open, while its source stalk is zero outside. This calculation applies to the given adjunctions themselves.

Preserve the middle biproduct with the additive abelian stalk functor. On the overlap use the retraction fst followed by the U counit followed by the inverse intersection counit, and the section inverse V counit followed by inr. The counit compatibility equations verify the splitting identities. On U minus V use the zero retraction and inverse U counit followed by inl; on V minus U use the zero retraction and inverse V counit followed by inr. The covering equation excludes the fourth case. The helper biprod_cover_shortExact proves all splitting identities in Lean.

The faithful forgetful functor to abelian sheaves is exact. Mathlib TopCat.Sheaf.exact_iff_stalkFunctor_map_exact reflects exactness; apply it to the displayed complex and also to the two complexes with zero first or zero second differential to reflect mono and epi. Combine the three results using ShortComplex.ShortExact.mk'.

proof_origin.place: Tag 08BU, stalk check of the short exact sequence, using Sheaves Tag 00A7
proof_origin.note: Compiled stalkwise splitting and exactness reflection; isolate the counit stalk calculation to avoid the existing derived-Hom import cycle.

lean.statement: theorem open_cover_mate_module_shortExact_core (X : AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSpace.{u}) (R : Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) RingCat.{u}) (_hR : R = (sheafCompose (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u} RingCat.{u})).obj X.sheaf) (U V : Opens X) (_hcover : U ⊔ V = ⊤) [(overFunctor.{u} R U).Additive] [(overFunctor.{u} R V).Additive] [(overFunctor.{u} R (U ⊓ V)).Additive] (SU : SheafOfModules.{u} (R.over U) ⥤ SheafOfModules.{u} R) (SV : SheafOfModules.{u} (R.over V) ⥤ SheafOfModules.{u} R) (SW : SheafOfModules.{u} (R.over (U ⊓ V)) ⥤ SheafOfModules.{u} R) [SU.Additive] [SV.Additive] [SW.Additive] (aU : SU ⊣ overFunctor.{u} R U) (aV : SV ⊣ overFunctor.{u} R V) (aW : SW ⊣ overFunctor.{u} R (U ⊓ V)) (F : SheafOfModules.{u} R) (iU iV : (SW.obj ((overFunctor.{u} R (U ⊓ V)).obj F)) ⟶ _) (hU : iU ≫ aU.counit.app F = aW.counit.app F) (hV : iV ≫ aV.counit.app F = aW.counit.app F) (hz : biprod.lift iU (-iV) ≫ biprod.desc (aU.counit.app F) (aV.counit.app F) = 0) : (ShortComplex.mk (biprod.lift iU (-iV)) (biprod.desc (aU.counit.app F) (aV.counit.app F)) hz).ShortExact
